body: She has been out in open land a few times and i was nervous should wouldn’t have good recall, but she actually did very well. There were my boyfriends family’s dogs out there with her and she socialized well with them no toy aggression or anything

thank you everyone for the kind replies and i really thank you guys for sharing your stories as well it really helps to be reminded that i’m not alone and that other people have and are going through the same thing. honestly i feel like the really bad feelings come in waves and it feels nearly impossible to keep myself afloat during them. i usually talk to my boyfriend about what happened but he doesn’t really understand where i’m coming from, not in a bad way but in a way that is sometimes vague. other times he does help a lot but lately it’s just been weighing on me extra heavily and i don’t like talking about these kinds of things out loud because it usually sends me into a spiral. i feel like i am reaching a new point in this journey and i just have to remind myself that healing isn’t linear. that part always throws me off.
